NativeResponse.description: The backend's own answer, in its own format (for Prometheus and Loki a `status`/`data` envelope; for Tempo the trace or the search result), including its own error shape for a bad query.

access.description: What the credential you presented may read.

rawQueries.description: Whether PromQL, LogQL and TraceQL as written are allowed (only when nothing is limited).

id.description: The service's id in Ikhnos (the topology's, or the record's of a service written in by hand).

aliases.description: Other names its telemetry may carry as service.name (its app label).

signals.description: The signals FUSION has for it in the range, matched by service name.

Application.description: An Ikhnos application: a group of services.

signals.description: The signals any of its services has in the range.

unresolvedMembers.description: Members Ikhnos has an id for but cannot tie to a running service (a cluster that is not connected, a service that has gone), so they are not listed. Absent when none.

warnings.description: Why a source failed, and which lists were built from a sample and may miss services.

applications.description: The Ikhnos applications this service is in; empty for a service no application has.

warnings.description: Why a source failed, and which lists were built from a sample and may miss services.

id.description: An application's id (not set for a service).

services.description: For an application: the service names its telemetry may carry.

errorTraces.description: The most recent with an error span.

metricsTruncated.description: It reports more metric names than are listed.

LinkTraffic.description: What was measured on a link. A zero is as often "not measured" as "none": only eBPF sees round trips and retransmits.

ApplicationTopology.description: One application's services, the traffic around them and what changed. Pointers, not telemetry: read that with `application` on the other routes.

asOf.description: The moment the answer describes: the topology's own for a live read, `at` for a past one.

snapshotAt.description: History only: when the recording the answer is drawn from was made (the newest at or before `at`).

status.description: Worst-case roll-up of the services' replicas: down when none has a replica ready, degraded when some are not fully ready, unknown when none is in the topology.

key.description: `name/namespace/cluster`: the identity telemetry knows the service by, and the `member` label of the application info series.

filter.description: The label values its telemetry carries.

workload.description: For the metrics the cluster reports about the workload itself, the label that names it (`k8s_deployment_name`, `k8s_statefulset_name` or `k8s_daemonset_name`).

links.description: Live links first, the busiest first.

from.description: A service's key, or the id of an address in `externals`.

direction.description: Between two services of the application, from one to something else, or from something else to one.

neighbours.description: The services outside the application that have traffic with it.

applications.description: The applications it is in (empty in a past answer).

externals.description: Addresses outside the clusters its services talk to. Only for a token that is not limited to certain namespaces or clusters.

calledBy.description: Keys of its services that call it.

changes.description: Newest first: events about the application, its services and the links shown.

unresolvedMembers.description: Members Ikhnos has an id for but cannot tie to a running service.

truncated.description: Which parts were cut at their maximum: 2000 links, 200 neighbours, 50 addresses, 100 events.

Sources.description: What became of each part of a read: ok; not requested; not allowed (the credential does not include that signal); unavailable (the store is off or starting); error.

categories.description: The category of each name (system, kubernetes or application).

truncated.description: True when the store had more than `limit`; narrow the filter or the range.
True when the store had more than `limit`; narrow the filter or the range.

category.description: What the signal is about, by its name.

points.description: Left off when a fused read's point budget ran out; the summary below is always there.

category.description: What the signal is about, by the namespace of the pod that wrote it.

QueryResult.description: One of your promql queries: on a resource for its expansion there, in the fused object's `queries` for a query not about one resource, on a span cut to its time.

query.description: The expression as it was evaluated, variables replaced (not repeated on spans).

error.description: Why this query has no series; the others are not affected.

ResourceTopology.description: Fused with topology: what Ikhnos knows about the service behind a resource, as of now (associated by name, namespace and cluster, not proven).

calls.description: Services and external addresses it was seen calling.

ChangeEvent.description: Something Ikhnos recorded about the estate near the trace.

resource.description: The key of the trace resource it is about, when it is about one.
The key of the entry in `resources` that produced it.

logs.description: Fused: the lines written under this span's id (exact).

metrics.description: Fused: the points of the resource's series inside this span's own time, widened by span_pad (associated, not proven).

queries.description: Fused with promql_spans: your per-resource queries cut to this span's time.

metrics.description: Fused: the series over the trace's whole time.

logs.description: Fused with context_logs: lines this resource wrote around the trace that carry no trace id, oldest first.

queries.description: Fused with promql: your queries that name ${service} and the like, evaluated for this resource over the trace's window.

roots.description: Span ids with no parent in the trace.

truncated.description: The trace was larger than this API returns.

logs.description: What became of the trace-linked log lines. The lines of a span are on the span.

unmatched.description: Lines that carry the trace id but no span id, or the id of a span the trace does not have.

onFilteredSpans.description: Lines on spans a span_* filter left out (included in total and matched).

queries.description: Fused with promql: your queries that are not about one resource, over the trace's window.

changes.description: Fused with include=changes: events about the trace's services, nodes and clusters shortly before and after it, oldest first.

spansOmitted.description: Spans the span_* filters left out; spanCount is that of the whole trace.

joins.description: In words, how each requested signal was tied to the trace: logs by the ids they carry (exact), metrics by service, namespace, pod and time (associated, not proven).

warnings.description: A part that could not be read is named here and in sources; the trace itself always comes back or the whole read fails.

status.description: 200, or what the single read would have answered (400 not a trace id, 404 no such trace, 504 not read in time ...).

BulkResult.description: As JSON: results in the order of the ids. As NDJSON (`stream=true`): one line `{"type":"result", ...BulkItem}` per trace in finishing order, then `{"type":"summary", ...BulkSummary}`.

TraceList.description: Without fused: just `traces`. With fused=true: `results` holds each hit in full, in the order of `traces`. As NDJSON: a first line `{"type":"traces", "traces":[...]}`, then the result and summary lines of a batch.

truncated.description: True when the store had more than `limit`; narrow the filter or the range.

BatchRequest.description: `ids` and any parameter of the fused read, as JSON: lists as arrays, durations as strings, numbers as numbers.

promql.description: Your own queries: an object of name to expression, or a list of `name=expression` strings.
